paragraphs: Mentioned in Eruvin 34b: he raised an objection against Rav Nachman.[^1]

notes.text: אותיב means raised an objection in this Talmudic construction, not “seated him.” Ukva is the understood subject and Rav Nachman the explicit recipient. לד: gives Eruvin 34b under the colon convention; no named edition is independently checked. Both Rav titles are explicit.
